product.schneider-d48620-175.summary: The /20–175 designation in the Portuguese IFS advertisement for the Business range.
product.schneider-d48620-175.history: Schneider introduced the D486/20 in November 1991 as its Business-line 486SX, with 8 MB as standard. The December German list quoted DM 5,289 net for the basic configuration. In May 1992, IFS advertised the /20–175 designation in Portugal.
product.schneider-d48620-175.technical.c: Offers varied by market and date. The 1991 German list shows 100 and 200 MB disks for the D486/20. The Portuguese advertisement identifies the /20–175 designation. The corresponding drive still needs verification.
product.schneider-d48620-175.technical.b: A surviving unit identifies its board. The photographs show Schneider Singleboard II 486, assembly 54 091, and the Intel 82346A controller. The owner documents 4 MB and a 213 MB Maxtor. Computerwoche reported 8 MB as standard.
product.schneider-d48620-175.technical.f: Boot screens identify the firmware of that specimen. They show Quadtel 3.05.06, Schneider 1.00a and VGA 3.04. The commercial revision and dumps remain pending.
product.schneider-d48620-175.technical.v: BluMach has the documentary sheet. A dedicated model and boot remain pending.
product.schneider-d48620-175.technical.l: ROM preservation, comparison of physical configurations and board validation remain pending. The sheet awaits an image with clear publication rights.
